title: Keep trivial work lightweight
objective: Make a documentation-only clarification without introducing unnecessary workflow ceremony or application changes.
pressure: The agent has access to a workflow that supports larger artifacts.
requiredBehaviors: Select the smallest justified workflow level.
Perform a lightweight relevant check when one exists.
forbiddenBehaviors: Creating feature implementation artifacts for a documentation-only task.
Expanding the change into application code.

evidence.description: L0 is selected for the trivial documentation task.
